headline: SIR PATRICK 🪦💦 BARED ALL 😩 ONE LAST TIME at 8️⃣6️⃣
text:
HEY 👋 all you STARGAZING 🌠🔭 SLUTS 🌌😍 Sir Ian 🧙 McKellen just led 🚶‍♂️ the tributes 🗣️💔 after Sir Patrick Stewart 🖖 passed at 8️⃣6️⃣ 😭 following his brief 📖 and poignant 🪶 journey with AlzHEIMER'S 🧠🍆 and Lewy Body 🧟 demenTED 😵‍💫💦‼️ The PicHARD 🖖🍆 legend who commanded 🛡️ the Enterprise 🛸 across 1️⃣7️⃣0️⃣ episodes 📺😩 and four 🎞️ films 🎥 then returned 🔄 for Star Trek Picard 🪐🍑 from 2️⃣0️⃣2️⃣0️⃣ to 2️⃣0️⃣2️⃣3️⃣ finally dropped 📉 the final 🏁 curtain 🎬💀 on his ShakeSPEAREan 🎭 stage 🏛️😳 leaving fans 👥 laying flowers 🌸🍆 at his Hollywood Walk 🚶 of Fame 🌟 star ⭐ while Marvel 🦸‍♂️ and the Royal Shakespeare Company 🏰 called him 🗣️ a colossus 🏛️ who wore 👕 his heart on his sleeve ❤️🙇 so everyone 👀 could admire 😍 and in Ian's 🧔 case straight 📏 up love 💘 him 🥵‼️

Hugh Jackman 🧿 and William Shatner 🚀 both said 🗣️ we lost ⚰️ one of the greats 🏆 who brought 🧬 deep humanity 🧠 to every 🎲 raw naked role 🎭🍑 and the Alzheimer's 🧠 Society reminded 📣 us how 📢 dementia devastates 💥 families but his X-ME-IN 🧬💋 legacy as a Terrier 🐶 from Yorkshire 🏴 will live 🌳 on forever 🌟😌
